criteria.text: Main Settings uses the same list width, typography, spacing, selected-row treatment, inspector hierarchy, and action placement as the shared design in #1513.
criteria.test_id: issue-1521-c1: main Settings renders through the shared list-and-inspector primitive

criteria.text: Each left-hand row has a clear title and one short explanatory subtitle or useful status; detailed forms and actions appear in the main inspector after selection.
criteria.test_id: issue-1521-c2: rows stay compact while two selections show their full inspectors

criteria.text: All existing settings and functions remain reachable: appearance, keyboard/safety preferences, workspace information, join-code management, members/roles, Facilities Manager access, notifications, account/access destinations, sign-out, runtime health/version, and release access.
criteria.test_id: issue-1521-c3: every existing Settings action is reachable from an inspector

criteria.text: Current values are loaded from the appropriate existing source, and edits retain their existing persistence scope. Clearly distinguish device/user preferences from workspace administration.
criteria.test_id: issue-1521-c4: device preferences persist per account and workspace values come from the gateway

criteria.text: Preserve admin-only permissions, self-management restrictions, relevant confirmations, and disabled/pending/error feedback. Selecting a row must not itself change a setting or execute an action.
criteria.test_id: issue-1521-c5: selection is inert and staff permissions remain read-only

criteria.text: Related destinations such as Agent Settings, Integrations, Mobile Access, and memory remain discoverable without duplicating their entire editors into main Settings.
criteria.test_id: issue-1521-c6: related destination rows navigate without duplicating editors

criteria.text: Mouse and keyboard selection work with visible focus and selected state. Long labels, smaller windows, and scrolling do not hide essential controls.
criteria.test_id: issue-1521-c7: keyboard, narrow, zoom, focus, and axe behavior remain usable

criteria.text: Loading, unavailable, empty, and read-only states are clear; switching sections does not silently discard unsaved edits or show stale details.
criteria.test_id: issue-1521-c8: loading error empty missing and unsaved states are explicit
